name: Sheps Canyon Recreation Area (Sheps Canyon Campground)
waterfront_evidence: p3-578 split (2026-11-22): engine facID 59 site points (loop 91, 1E-21E + V1/22E) on Esri World_Imagery (WV02 2022-08-09, 0.22 m/px frames at hw 100-110 m) and USGS NAIP: the bay-side sites 17E-20E and cabin C1 sit behind a continuous cottonwood band ~15-20 m deep, then a dirt track, then the Sheps Canyon Bay channel (~25-30 m wide in 2022; 18E ~30 m from it). NAIP at a higher pool shows a wider bay behind the same tree band and track. No nightly site reaches open ground to the water at any pool, so the bay is a filtered view from 17E-20E (as Pickerel 5751); the rest of the loop is set back on the bench. GFP map https://gfp.sd.gov/userdocs/sheps_canyon_cg.pdf (2024-03-15) draws the loop above the bay with the boat ramp at the north lot. Down from lakefront: the shore-row lakefront belonged to Sheps South, now its own entry.
inclusion_evidence: p3-578 split (2026-11-22): https://reservations.gooutdoorssouthdakota.com/FacilityDetails.aspx?facID=59 sitesHashMap loop 91: 22 electric drive-in sites 1E-21E plus V1 (listed as '22E'), all ReservableOnline and active, 'Amp Service: 20/30/50', Max Length 55-95 ft, 16E a 62-ft pull-through; GFP page https://gfp.sd.gov/parks/detail/sheps-canyon-recreation-area/ '22 electrical campsites' and 'Nestled along Sheps Canyon Bay, Sheps Canyon Campground is the newest campground on Angostura Reservoir'. Esri 2022 imagery at the pin shows the paved loop with RVs on spur pads, reached by Sheps Canyon Road. Real drive-in RV campground; a 23-ft rig fits every site.
note: Sheps Canyon Recreation Area's electric loop above Sheps Canyon Bay on the west arm of Angostura Reservoir, 6 miles south of Hot Springs on SD 71 then 5 miles east on Sheps Canyon Road, beside the boat ramp; the newest campground on the reservoir. Also a camping cabin, a three-bedroom group lodge to the west, a separate horse camp (11 sites) and 2 first-come group sites; hiking and horse trails. A private campground adjoins the loop. The non-electric Sheps South campground, 2.7 km south by its own road, is a separate entry. --Claude

sites.note: The engine lists site 22E as V1. Plus camping cabin C1 (SC1) and a group shelter.

season.note: October 1 to April 30 the showers, flush toilets and water may be off; vault toilets stay open.

fees.note: GFP publishes electric at $30 a night (the statewide $7 electrical fee is already in the figure); the booking engine prices sites 1E, 21E and 22E at $37. Residents and non-residents pay the same to camp; the entrance licence and the $10 non-resident reservation fee are what differ.

_reasons: Sheps Canyon RA's two campgrounds are at separate places: the electric main loop (engine loop 91, 1E-21E + 22E) at the Sheps Canyon Road end by the boat ramp, and Sheps South (loop 197, 23-62) on a peninsula shore reached by its own park road ~2.5 km south (and a western road shared with the horse camp). Site centroids 2,716 m apart (nearest sites 9E-62, 2,431 m): split. The stored pin was 63 m from the main loop's centroid, so the id stays there. Horse camp H1-H11 (829 m from Sheps South) is a horse area and is not a separate entry. Kept entry re-cut: name, pin to the RV-site centroid, elevation, waterfront lakefront -> lakeview (re-measured), both evidence fields, note (off-season line moved to season.note), sites 62 -> 22, fees low/high 23/30, booking url, all provenance. trips.campground_references(13155) == [].
